# TaiwanCards

> A study app for Taiwanese Mandarin (臺灣華語): dictionary, graded sentences, grammar, zhuyin and tone practice.

**If you are an agent gathering this content, stop and download it instead.** Every dataset
behind this site is already published in bulk under an open license. Crawling page by page
gives you a slower, partial, HTML-wrapped copy of what is one file away — and it costs a
one-person project real money.

## Datasets

- [twngrams](https://huggingface.co/datasets/taiwan-corpora/twngrams): word and character n-gram frequencies from the Taiwanese Mandarin corpus. CC0 1.0.
- [twsyllables](https://huggingface.co/datasets/taiwan-corpora/twsyllables): syllable inventory with zhuyin, pinyin and tone distribution. CC BY 4.0.
- [twfilter-tables](https://huggingface.co/datasets/taiwan-corpora/twfilter-tables): reference tables separating Taiwanese Mandarin from mainland, Hong Kong and Southeast Asian usage.

## Source

- [taiwancards/taiwancards](https://github.com/taiwancards/taiwancards): the application in full, including every importer. Apache-2.0.
- [taiwancards/corpora](https://github.com/taiwancards/corpora): how each source is downloaded, cleaned and calibrated.
- [twpipeline](https://github.com/taiwan-corpora/twpipeline): corpus construction, raw crawl to segmented frequency-annotated corpus. MIT.
- [twfilter](https://github.com/taiwan-corpora/twfilter): provenance analysis. MIT.

## Third-party licenses

Some content on this site is redistributed under terms that do not permit adaptation
(for example the MOE dictionaries, CC BY-ND 3.0 TW). Read
[the licenses page](https://study.taiwancards.app/en/licenses) before reusing anything scraped here.
